cases.situation: My manager just asked me on Slack to build the competitor pricing dashboard by Friday. I already have the quarterly board report due Thursday and a client migration Wednesday. It's realistically 3 days of work.
cases.reply: Happy to take the pricing dashboard, I think it'll be useful. Quick priority check though: I've got the Norland migration Wednesday and the board report Thursday, and the dashboard is about three days' work on its own. Options: I deliver a first version with the top five competitors Friday and the full one next Wednesday, or the board report moves to Monday and I focus on the dashboard. My recommendation is the first. Which do you prefer?
cases.note: Align, name the constraint in days, show the trade-off, recommend, and ask them to choose.

cases.situation: 老板在会上决定把我们产品的免费试用期从30天砍到7天，我觉得会严重影响转化，但会上没好意思说。想会后私聊他。
cases.reply: 张总，关于试用期改成7天的决定，想在正式执行前提一个顾虑。我们的数据里，付费用户有将近一半是在第10到25天之间转化的，改成7天可能会直接砍掉这部分。如果这个已经考虑过了，我就全力配合推进。如果还没有，可以先拿一个渠道试行两周，看数据再全面推，您觉得呢？
cases.note: 私下提，不当众；用数据说风险，给出一个低成本的替代方案，并留出'已考虑过就配合'的台阶。

cases.situation: Pushed back on my boss about delivering the grant application and the donor newsletter both by Monday. She said 'I need both, figure it out.' I'm a program coordinator at a nonprofit.
cases.reply: Understood, I'll make Monday the priority for both. To be clear, that means the newsletter goes out with three stories instead of five, and the volunteer training schedule moves to Wednesday. I'll send the grant application for your review by 2pm Monday.
cases.note: When they insist, don't argue a second time. Say what slips, in writing, and deliver what you said.

cases.situation: My boss Alan just texted asking me to finish the investor memo over the weekend. Saturday is my sister's wedding and I'm a bridesmaid. It's about a day of work.
cases.reply: Hi Alan, I can't work on it this weekend, it's my sister's wedding on Saturday and I'm in the wedding party. I can start first thing Monday and have the memo to you by noon. If it truly can't wait, I can send you my outline and the latest numbers tonight so you can pick it up. Which would you prefer?
cases.note: A clear no to the weekend, then what it would take and a choice for him. No long apology for having a life.

cases.situation: My boss Rachel wants me to tell our client Brightline on Thursday's status call that the app launch is on track for Oct 20. QA has 14 blocking bugs open and my honest estimate is Nov 3.
cases.reply: Rachel, I want Thursday's call with Brightline to go well and keep their trust. Right now QA has 14 blocking bugs open, and my honest estimate for launch is November 3, not October 20. If we say on track and then slip, it will cost us more with them than two weeks will. Two options: tell them Thursday about the new date with the fix plan, or launch the core flows on the 20th and ship payments on the 3rd. I'd go with the second. Could you decide by tomorrow so I can prepare the deck?
cases.note: Pushing back on being asked to mislead a client: frame it around the relationship both of you want to protect, and give options that are all honest.

cases.situation: 我是公司的数据分析师，三个月来老板一直让我顺手帮他订差旅、整理报销，现在每周要花五六个小时，数据报表经常拖到周末做。想跟他提一下。
cases.reply: 刘总，想跟您对一下我这边的工作安排。这三个月我一直在帮您订差旅、整理报销，偶尔急用我很乐意帮忙，但现在每周要占五六个小时，周报和月度经营分析经常只能挪到周末赶。想请您定一下：要么正式把这部分算进我的工作，相应调整报表的优先级；要么交回行政部。我更倾向于交回行政，这样月报能保证每月5号出。您看哪种合适？
cases.note: 说清占用的时间和因此被挤掉的核心工作，给两个选项和自己的倾向，让老板来做选择。
